blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — The National Historical Commission of the Philippines (NHCP) has reiterated that construction of the proposed Oslob Sports and Cultural Center cannot proceed without its clearance, as the agency continues reviewing the project’s impact on the town’s heritage area. The reminder followed a concerned resident’s report of barricades and possible development activity inside Oslob town plaza, where the proposed facility was earlier planned. In a September 30 letter to Oslob Mayor Ronald Guaren, NHCP Chair Regalado Trota Jose Jr. said that the commission’s evaluation of the proposed development remains ongoing, with concerns over its potential effects on the […]...
